review: Read all ten complete new sources and pinned Weierstrass discriminant, affine equation/nonsingularity, tangent/secant and actual Point addition APIs. Four primary SHA256/Git blobs checked.

The actual original cubic is nonsingular for n nonzero. Three actual roots with product minus y construct a genuine group half; denominator and half-ordinate nonvanishing are proved from n nonzero. Converse uses the actual Point cases and doubling formula, including the zero/two-torsion exclusions.

Identity Kummer class is equivalent to actual doubling for the retained non-two-torsion point domain. Prior rational torsion involution is identified with addition by the genuine nonzero two-torsion point, and the same original RationalPoint embeds into this curve group.
Verified753 source/evidence bindings and743 exact predecessor copies. Supplemental author symbolic/rational regressions are not a kernel proof or independent reexecution claim.
